evidence.claim: The case-memory scorer, trained on the bank's closed cases, rates the flagged transaction's fraud probability at 0.8491 (calibrated to 0.7674), close to the real-time risk_score of 0.87.
This card, C09933-K2, has 18 prior closed cases with outcome confirmed_fraud (patterns account_takeover and out_of_region_use), the most recent opened 2016-10-31 (CC-5521).

8 of those confirmed-fraud closed cases (including CC-5521, CC-4787, CC-4597, CC-4455, CC-3136, CC-2834) were labeled account_takeover and occurred in the card's modal region 264.0, establishing that an in-region purchase is this card's own established fraud shape rather than an automatic safety signal.

A second transaction in the pre-open window, 3514573 ($36.97, in-person, region 264.0, 2016-12-04 22:40:36), also scores high on the case-memory scorer (cms_p 0.72), clustering with the flagged transaction 3514948 (cms_p 0.85) and an earlier one, 3508487 ($116.96, cms_p 0.85, 2016-12-02 23:10:43), against a background of thousands of near-zero cms_p transactions on this card.

Amount $111.92 is within the card's baseline as of opening (2431 prior transactions, median $77.04, maximum $2,529.78), and region 264.0 is the card's modal in-person region (2220 prior purchases across 155 days, with home activity continuing in the 48h window at 24 home vs 2 other) — the ordinary-use reading of these otherwise unremarkable episode transactions.

recurring_charge_check found $111.92 (±1%) recurring 5 times on this card under product code W at region 264.0 (median gap 16.0 days, gap CV 0.60), but this fails the R7 cadence/probability gate because the flagged transaction's cms_p (0.849) exceeds the 0.30 ceiling required for the recurring-charge exception, so R7 does not exempt it from block/verify action.

case.summary: Verdict fraud at probability 0.77 on card C09933-K2, pattern account_takeover: the chain-scoped episode (3508487, 3514573, 3514948; exposure $265.85) sits in the card's home region 264.0, decisive on 18 prior confirmed-fraud closed cases in this same region plus a clustered high-memory-score transaction beside the flagged one, though the amount/cadence alone could otherwise read as an ordinary recurring purchase. A customer_validation request went unanswered within 24 hours, so the final recommendation is DECLINE_TRANSACTION and BLOCK_CARD (both awaiting L1 approval), alongside CREATE_CASE and MONITOR_CARD.
